wire_adaptation: Proposed revision2 changes only S3; all S1/S2 contracts remain their exact existing revision1. Runtime values/capabilities are never serialized by object introspection.
closure_rules: Every role and parameter key from the operation entry occurs once. No undeclared key. Required known/effect minima are operation admission predicates, not permission to discard incomplete history.
KnownRef targets resolve to exact listed types. A driver extension uses a selected exact input/output contract; unknown critical payload grammars hold execution.
S3 typed_payload.reference_context explicitly binds all embedded references to that package/format; never infer context from the S1 artifact storage package.
No unresolved reference receives a stand-in UUID. Unknown S2 binding preserves evidence but blocks a newly issued scientific run.
Every returned effect boundary is per-command, independent of operation return state. Exceptions/crash after prepared intent retain possible effects until reconciled.
No coordinator may receive a valid LiveAdmission when a required owner decision/hold/validity or strict guarantee is unresolved.
grammar_rules: All parameter grammar fields required/closed. Native driver parameters select one exact declared contract with a supplied pure decoder; no arbitrary dictionary fallback.
Only nonnegative finite quantities in capacity/charge fields, positive canonical Index text for limits, start<=end for byte ranges, valid UTC instants/uncertainties, and exact source-selector bounds.

Changing effect content/key/recipient/required guarantee needs a new related command. Changing runtime ownership requires an explicit new admission and forwarding occurrence; it does not extend native idempotency retention or mutate the original command.
An empty native lookup needs adequate negative coverage/retention/incarnation to prove no acceptance; unknown stays unknown.
Secret slots name owner-managed runtime inputs; the values and bearer tokens are not captured in these public records. Missing secret-version evidence limits reproducibility claims.

native_identity_projection.encoding: strict base64 of compact UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false, no normalization, prefixed s3-incarnation-key-v1:
native_identity_projection.output: S1 native_id derived registry key, with authority/namespace retained and source.basis=derived; raw descriptor/bridge receipt pinned
native_identity_projection.limits: Driver must explicitly support this bridge and use raw native coordinates for provider calls. Unknown incarnation requires a separate positively established literal-unique identity rule, not empty substitution.

owner_correlation_law: correlation identifies the stable reservation/authority subject binding; request_occurrence identifies one immutable reserve/reconcile/renew/settle/release/authorize request. Same request occurrence plus changed parameters conflicts. Renewal/settlement uses a new request occurrence and expected revision under the same unchanged subject binding. Reconcile names the exact lost request occurrence; no second hold or renewal inferred.
transmission_law: Command C is immutable exact intended effect; D is an allocated forwarding occurrence with its own durable issue transaction and per-boundary observation. Never update an old D with newly learned receipt/time. Later evidence references it. Recovery looks up the exact transaction before deciding whether another D is permitted. A new D/owner epoch may reuse C only with explicit current admission and still-valid native single-effect guarantee; no changed payload/key/recipient/required guarantee under C.
scientific_binding_law: Scientific-run purpose or an otherwise applicable S2 intent requires exactly one established run binding and actual matching conditions before issue. A fixed, explicitly non-scientific preparation/probe commission can use a positively justified NA scientific binding, while retaining all actual native effects, costs/exposure and S2 contamination/history consequences. Purpose cannot be relabeled after results or used to override visible C01 triggers.
external_origin_recovery_law: The one-parent restart profile accepts an established s1.attempt or an adequate known s3.native_subject as predecessor. Unknown original S1 A/R stays unresolved; S3 driver support, actual native state/stop/ownership and scientific policy remain required. Exact S1 recovery projection is unavailable without its real predecessor/successor attempt identities; do not fabricate them. Multi-parent continuation uses a separately registered typed contract, not this one-parent profile.
serialization_inheritance: Common package/envelope/reference/index/knowledge/value forms inherit the exact pinned base catalog, except the explicit revision2 payload/primitive replacements and additions here. Core record contract versions and package format are revision2; S1/S2 remain revision1.
namespace_delta_law: Runtime RecordDelta partitions new S3 records, owned S1 native additions and owned S2 scientific additions. They never share a serialized records array. Before append/capture commit, freeze owned additions in their own exact formats and resolve bridge/pin context into immutable PinnedViews; only CommitDelta enters the durable journal. Failure leaves staging/orphan/uncertain commit evidence, not a published cursor.
